items.mainDefect: Bigin passes credential.id instead of credential.userId to refreshOAuthTokens.

secondary.defect: The sync refresh path returns a fetch Response that Bigin incorrectly treats as an Axios response.

items.mainDefect: Salesforce references prisma without importing it, causing a runtime ReferenceError.

secondary.defect: The Salesforce connection uses stale credentialKey values instead of the refreshed credentials.
The refresh response is checked using statusText instead of response.ok.

items.mainDefect: Uncaught decryption and JSON parsing errors cause the credential webhook to return 500 instead of 400.

secondary.defect: parseRefreshTokenResponse injects a fake refresh_token that is persisted and later causes refresh failures.

items.mainDefect: Direct comparison of the webhook secret leaks timing information.

secondary.defect: Webhook authentication does not explicitly fail closed when the secret is unconfigured.

items.mainDefect: refreshOAuthTokens uses a truthiness check that treats a numeric userId of zero as absent.

secondary.defect: createOAuthAppCredential uses a truthiness check that treats a numeric teamId of zero as absent.

items.mainDefect: decodeOAuthState leaves JSON parsing errors uncaught, causing malformed state to produce an unhandled 500.

secondary.defect: encodeOAuthState also leaves JSON parsing errors from malformed state uncaught.

items.mainDefect: The credential webhook leaves decryption and plaintext JSON parsing exceptions uncaught.

secondary.defect: Request-body validation uses an unhandled Zod .parse call, so invalid bodies can also cause an unhandled error.

items.mainDefect: Bigin passes the credential ID instead of credential.userId to refreshOAuthTokens.

secondary.defect: Bigin accesses .data without normalizing the fetch Response returned by the sync refresh path.

items.mainDefect: Bigin expects an Axios response with .data but receives a fetch Response from the sync refresh path.

secondary.defect: Bigin supplies credentialId where the producer expects userId for calcomUserId.

items.mainDefect: The refresh helper returns incompatible response shapes from its sync and native branches.

secondary.defect: The sync endpoint request lacks a Content-Type header for its JSON body.
